O3_reason_to_dismiss: cms_page belongs to the 'Add translation' feature, not Duplicate, and visible page-type 'source' choices are shared templates any page creator may build on - so a solver fixing 'duplicate reads any page' can argue both are a different feature.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Users allowed to add pages must still be able to (a) duplicate pages they can view/change, (b) create pages from this site's page types via the visible source select, and (c) add a translation to a page they can change; the tree copy route copies across sites for users who can view the source. An over-broad fix (requiring superuser/change on every source, site-filtering source for all copies, or rejecting cms_page outright) breaks these.
